kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-ad-connector-directory --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name corp.example.com --domain-user-name sAMAccountName --domain-password testPassword --directory-name testDirectoryName --dns-address 127.0.XX.XX --vswitch-id vsw-bp19ocz3erfx15uon0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateADConnectorDirectory

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the enterprise AD, which includes both the hostname and domain name. The same domain name can be registered only once
parameters.help_zh: 输入企业AD的全限定域名（FQDN），同时带有主机名和域名。相同的域名只能注册一次
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The username of the domain administrator. The username can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 域管理员的用户名。最长支持64个英文字符
parameters.name: domain_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the domain administrator. The password can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 域管理员的用户密码。最长支持64个英文字符
parameters.name: domain_password

parameters.help_en: The directory name. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 目录名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: directory_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to grant local administrator permissions to users who use cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限
parameters.name: enable_admin_access

parameters.help_en: The method allowed for connecting to cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 连接云电脑时允许使用的方式
parameters.name: desktop_access_type

parameters.help_en: The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the existing enterprise AD subdomain, which includes both the hostname and domain name
parameters.help_zh: 企业已有AD子域的全限定域名（FQDN），同时带有主机名和域名
parameters.name: sub_domain_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable MFA. After MFA is enabled, all AD users in this directory must enter a dynamic verification code generated by a virtual MFA device in addition to the correct password when logging on to cloud computers.

MFA device binding is required upon first logon
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用MFA认证。开启后，该目录下的所有AD用户登录云电脑时，输入正确密码后，还需输入虚拟MFA设备生成的动态验证码。

首次登录时，需绑定MFA设备
parameters.name: mfa_enabled

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the DNS server for the enterprise AD. Currently, only one IP address can be specified. Make sure that this IP address is accessible from the selected vSwitch network
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD对应DNS的IP地址。目前仅支持设置一个。请确保该IP地址在所选的交换机网络下可以访问
parameters.name: dns_address

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. Currently, only one vSwitch ID can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID。目前仅支持设置一个
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The DNS address of the existing enterprise AD subdomain. If `SubDomainName` is specified but this parameter is not, the subdomain DNS is considered the same as the parent domain DNS
parameters.help_zh:
企业已有AD子域的DNS地址。    
如果设置了`SubDomainName`，而未设置此参数，则认为子域DNS和父域一致
parameters.name: sub_domain_dns_address

DirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the AD directory
